title: Welcome to the Lubavitch Historical Archive Project
author: Project Team
excerpt: This project documents the history, sacred sites, and ongoing restoration work in Lubavitch.
body: Lubavitch is a small village with a vast spiritual history. This archive presents restoration updates, historical notes, and visual documentation. Historical facts must be verified before final publication.

title: The Ohel of the Rebbeim Undergoes Renovation
author: Editorial Desk
excerpt: A respectful renovation of the Ohel associated with the Tzemach Tzedek and the Rebbe Maharash was completed.
body: According to published sources, renovation work connected with the Ohel area was completed in 2024. Wording requires verification before publication.
